text: Thornico is a family-owned conglomerate formed by father and son Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil, who secured their investments in hummel; Thornico's group structure lists hummel A/S of Aarhus, Denmark.
short: hummel A/S is owned by the Stadil family's Thornico group.

source.name: Thornico: 'About Thornico — a family-owned conglomerate' (thornico.com)
source.quote: A FAMILY-OWNED CONGLOMERATE THORNICO ... father and son, Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil, secured their investments in hummel
